archival_decision_or_proposal: The October 11 correction withdrew author-matching tags, JSON reserialization, SHA-256 and optional after. It retained per-author prev/seq and fork refusal.
recommended_disposition: Replace the superseded event recipe. Keep a profile-aware legacy decoder and label the input profile at import.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: A legacy artifact still verifies over its original bytes. A new signed event uses its specified profile. A third-party tag carries the tagger’s identity.

archival_decision_or_proposal: Pull pagination acquired byte and count limits plus an oversized-record exception. The baseline documented host.wasm omissions.
recommended_disposition: Carry the page contract into relay catch-up. A test skip requires an explicit fixture reason.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Mix a single oversized object with many small ones. The resume cursor yields each accepted ID exactly once.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The initial workload led to a redb-only decision after a Turso measurement. This predates edition ports and their parity fixtures.
recommended_disposition: Retain the original workload as a regression fixture. Scope the old rejection to the measured storage path.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Test adapter semantics separately from workload performance. Preserve the reserved IndexedDB disposition for the existing owner.

archival_decision_or_proposal: Delegation and strong removal operate over event frontiers and membership validity.
recommended_disposition: Retain when adding portable capability or MCP vocabulary. Derive admission for the affected causal slice.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Permute receipt order around a removal. The final per-event membership disposition agrees.

archival_decision_or_proposal: LogSync and range reconciliation were compared on measured workloads, including a crossover used to drive selection.
recommended_disposition: Re-use both transcript fixtures. Recalibrate the crossover per workload and byte budget before choosing future defaults.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Peers with identical sets and divergent tails converge under both methods, including a restart after an incomplete range.

archival_decision_or_proposal: Group templates replaced a separate friendship pair model. Full history and recent-history windows coexist with key material and head rules.
recommended_disposition: Represent friendship with the existing group model. Specify the advertised historical window separately from membership proof.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Verify an accepted old signature after pruning and distinguish missing ciphertext or missing decryption authority.

archival_decision_or_proposal: Independent signers may make attributed claims. Observed removes and causal cuts govern what disappears from a view.
recommended_disposition: Reuse authorship and cut semantics for labels, fork marks and graph search. Keep local lens preferences separate.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Two signers tag one object. Removing one observed claim preserves the other and an unseen concurrent addition.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The plan chose a default five-minute freshness check, ticket option E, and device-fork recovery by removal and re-enrolment.
recommended_disposition: Document admission freshness, invitation depth and historical causal validity as independently tested rules.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: An expired invitation fails entry, an already accepted historical event still replays, and a removed device cannot acquire a new grant.

archival_decision_or_proposal: DHT publishing is opt-in and the record distinguished an approved design from provider deployment and network access.
recommended_disposition: Retain direct discovery. Recheck each specific deployment hold before activating an optional publisher.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: A direct invite succeeds with discovery disabled. A publisher serves only opted-in worlds.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The owner ruling fixes causal-validity-only as a permanent boundary for this track. The record distinguishes waiting, voided and frozen events.
recommended_disposition: Defer stronger time attestation and group-key research to separately authorized scopes. Surface missing evidence explicitly.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Changing receipt time alone cannot change causal membership outcome. Show the reason for each withheld or rejected item.

archival_decision_or_proposal: A transport-neutral screen, Roc protocol libraries and per-world execution policy form the input/output boundary.
recommended_disposition: Use one action and screen fixture through each shell. Attach shell-specific capabilities explicitly.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Replay the same menu action through terminal and graphical adapters. Compare semantic action and resulting screen.

archival_decision_or_proposal: Interactive worlds added roles, screens and ticks; the next-stage record called out journal compatibility, metering and trust gaps.
recommended_disposition: Publish compatibility and cost evidence before widening providers or regenerating histories.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Rollback fixture reads prior records and yields the same projection. A fixture pins compiler/config identity next to fuel.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The plan grouped CI truthfulness, cost visibility, host code separation and cheaper guests.
recommended_disposition: Keep the measurement rig and fixture alongside each claimed improvement.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: An absent guest fixture is reported and counted. Guest work, host effects and dispatch latency can be attributed independently.

archival_decision_or_proposal: Worlds as data, extension providers, guest languages, scale and authoring were independent acceptance tracks.
recommended_disposition: Use the later per-criterion audit to evaluate the release claim. Track outstanding rows individually.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: A passing capability extension cannot count as language conformance or an interactive latency measurement.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The Nov 22 audit reconciled earlier disagreements: criteria 2, 4, 5, 7, 8 and 9 met, 3 and 6 not met, and 1 unmeasured at its cited pin.
recommended_disposition: Tie each exit row to its run, input, commit and machine. Later benchmark metrics require unit and workload matching.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Measure empty-directory to first join separately; retain three-language and 100-active-world latency gates.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The client plan specifies common contract, transports, presentation tiers, native shells, client-side providers and topology.
recommended_disposition: Carry the common contract into release gates for Linux then Android, with device evidence for Android.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Run identical action/permission fixtures across shells and exercise suspension, resume and unavailable inputs with a device trace.

archival_decision_or_proposal: An earlier plan named Phase 14 around durable journal safety, measurement, verification, and extension gates. #6312 later identifies seven product themes.
recommended_disposition: Retain record-safety prerequisites. Distinguish this historical closure plan from the owner’s later seven-theme plan of record.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Cross-link each current theme to a release gate and an accountable issue. A phase name alone cannot confer authorization.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The design uses host mode in the same ID binary, the same journal, and an idle window with wake-up.
recommended_disposition: Retain one supervisor contract and one journal. Respect the linked implementation chain.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: A suspended world wakes from the same journal through local and hosted transports, with the same stable world and projections.

archival_decision_or_proposal: Announcements include sequence, expiry and coarse occupancy. Signed registry lists carry entries and reasoned tombstones.
recommended_disposition: Separate publisher custody, registry opinions and join authority. Support direct-invite entry with no registry subscription.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: A replayed announcement cannot replace a newer one. Delisting hides a local listing but cannot revoke a still-valid invite.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The closeout records local queries over signed registry copies, attributable inclusion and tombstones, republication continuity, and the v1 boundary around exact engagement counts.
recommended_disposition: Keep a reproducible local query path. Resolve disagreement between two subscribed curators as attributed opinions.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Compute an offline result from two conflicting registry lists. Disclose origin of each opinion; recheck v1 items 3 and 5 before implementation.

archival_decision_or_proposal: Local portable signed bundles, export/import and fork lineage predate public discovery.
recommended_disposition: Retain bundle verification and source attribution as the baseline distribution mechanism.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: A recipient imports a verified bundle offline, forks without overwriting the original and preserves the ancestor ID.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The registry record supports multiple publication paths, discovery and update channels over a shared scheme.
recommended_disposition: Treat a subscription as discovery of candidate versions. Re-evaluate added authority during activation.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: A signed update can be discovered offline from a mirrored list; it cannot enlarge the installed grant on its own.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The gallery reads D6 records. Author claims, operator categories and accountable curation are distinct.
recommended_disposition: Preserve separate signer and operator provenance when indexing and displaying programs.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Two gallery operators can disagree on curation while validating the same artifact and author.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The final issue comment records read-only mirroring, lineage-aware discovery, transparent first-pass moderation and team collections; the issue closed as designed.
recommended_disposition: Use the existing outline. Keep mirror-peer posture, count display, paid programs, machine-hold scope and team-key governance as owner decisions pending a newer ruling.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Verify a mirrored but unlisted artifact. Its signature is valid, local browsing respects local admission, and the operator can explain the difference.

archival_decision_or_proposal: v1 provides the initial shell-design contract and implementation slices inherited by v2.
recommended_disposition: Map portable semantics before adding platform-only affordances.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: A shell can report an unavailable action without changing the world state.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The v2 outline extends native and TUI coverage, ties GA packaging to first native target and conformance, and names hardware and third-party rungs.
recommended_disposition: Use the settled platform priority in release planning and verify prerequisites per issue.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: The second platform consumes exactly the shared fixture. Packaging evidence identifies OS, binary and capability profile.

archival_decision_or_proposal: MCP tool access and stale-decision guards bind effects to an observed world decision context.
recommended_disposition: Integrate the existing policy session and retain deterministic refusal plus human-visible receipts.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: A state change between observation and action produces a stale decision response; no effect executes.

archival_decision_or_proposal: World-defined distinct roles and per-agent quotas outlive individual sessions; owners can inspect effects.
recommended_disposition: Recover quota state on reconnect and re-evaluate role grants on change.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: A restarted client with the same principal cannot reset its quota simply by reconnecting.

archival_decision_or_proposal: Coordination, shared documents, handoffs and task boards live in auditable world state.
recommended_disposition: Use a shared object and record authority for transitions rather than importing broker state into worlds.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Two agents claim a task concurrently. Reconnect/replay exposes the same resulting state and competing proposals.

archival_decision_or_proposal: Hosted services list a program, hire and attach it, and impose explicit runtime and public-host trust policy.
recommended_disposition: Keep listing, hire and attach as separate authority transitions. Derive the agent’s ceiling from owner policy.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: A listed service has no world authority before attach; detachment refuses further effects and preserves past receipts.

archival_decision_or_proposal: A read-only owner inspection report is derived from the local journal and already-produced metrics, with a machine-readable representation.
recommended_disposition: Use the same report locally and through an authorized remote client. Leave unobserved periods unknown.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Turn off hosted reporting. Local output still identifies provenance and bounds for each metric.

archival_decision_or_proposal: Registered scale design distinguishes tiers and calls for concrete, reproducible measurements.
recommended_disposition: Separate steady execution, resident memory, compaction, join latency, and hard admission caps. Preserve item-specific holds.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: A matrix cell records participants, worlds, events, machine, commit and measurement method. A result at another denominator cannot fill it.

archival_decision_or_proposal: Source-level proposal passes platform contexts to pure libraries and checks the used set against capability ceilings.
recommended_disposition: Keep the import manifest and runtime admission as independently enforced checks.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: An underdeclared library fails the static gate when analysis is available; a forged or unchecked manifest still fails runtime effects.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The selected v1 swap uses a separate Wasm instance per function, restart at a tick boundary, and host snapshot/restore. Component-model dynamic linking was deferred.
recommended_disposition: Keep the settled mechanism and version the interface and state handoff before expanding placement.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Inject an incompatible candidate while calls are in flight. The prior binding remains active with its last valid state.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The proposed caching and pricing policy separates deterministic build identity, sharing scopes, eviction and private material from execution fuel.
recommended_disposition: Price and authorize compilation independently of reproducible execution receipts. Scope cache sharing to material allowed to cross tenants.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Two builds with different compiler pins cannot alias. A private cache entry cannot become discoverable through a public hit.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The reconciled research records independent Wasmtime stores per binding; it explicitly resolves disagreements between two earlier passes.
recommended_disposition: Use separate meters for guest instances and a bounded host-call budget. Keep research bounds distinct from results.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: A runaway binding exhausts its own allocation. Other bindings recover their state and report separate resource receipts.

archival_decision_or_proposal: KDL metadata proposes kind, published interfaces, attachment semantics, separate compile-in and dynamic modes, and URL plus pinned hash and version.
recommended_disposition: Keep source location, object identity, eligibility and policy as distinct fields.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Changing bytes at a URL fails the pin. Discovering an entity-attached library cannot grant permission to execute it.

archival_decision_or_proposal: A decided design supplies structured license identity, family, obligations and fact source to other checkers. Deployment policy is separate.
recommended_disposition: Preserve unknown and conflicting facts; keep classification separate from policy action.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Import/export preserves the evidence source. Two deployments can reach distinct admission decisions from identical input facts.

archival_decision_or_proposal: Note lineages are maximal unbranched paths in a signed revision DAG. Divergence, marks and merges are projections over a stable note ID.
recommended_disposition: Keep explicit revision references when introducing CRDT editing or graph ranking.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Two concurrent revisions remain inspectable; two clients derive the same lineage identifiers from the same signed DAG.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The design uses an authoritative subject directory, migration epoch, write fence and destination verification; it requires proof of supported placement before account creation.
recommended_disposition: Retain one writer across retries. Record capability evidence per storage binding and keep signup policy explicit.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Crash before and after cutover. Only the selected target may accept new writes after cutover; unresolved location fails explicitly.

archival_decision_or_proposal: Two address cores are proposed: immutable content and mutable array addresses. Names, streams, numeric registries and coordinate worlds derive from them.
recommended_disposition: Return scope, provenance, and causal cut when resolving a mutable name to an immutable address.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Two local name lenses may resolve differently. Both clients verify the resulting immutable object bytes.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The legacy compatibility work distinguishes raw BLAKE3 payloads and other original signing and hash profiles.
recommended_disposition: Make hash profile a required bridge field. Retain the raw Iroh blob vector.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: The same payload and signed assertion can have different identifiers. Import verifies each against the matching profile.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The proposed graph components cover decision slices separately from any wire freeze.
recommended_disposition: Require canonical byte, feed cursor, and graph projection fixtures before choosing interchange for publication.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Rebuild a view from signed facts, resume at its documented cut, then compare bytes and cursor ordering.

archival_decision_or_proposal: One ingress gate separates immutable bytes, signed assertion, peer acceptance and time-scoped location evidence; advice is never latent authority.
recommended_disposition: Apply identical validation at local ingress and mirror ingress. Keep placement distinct from trust.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: A valid signature from an inadmissible principal stays verifiable while local policy rejects the assertion.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The archived comparison treats Diamond Types as a text-only candidate; attribution of the intake word ‘diamonds’ remained uncertain.
recommended_disposition: Carry text traces forward as comparative fixtures and preserve explicit author-signature checks in the outer envelope.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Compare reconstructed text after offline edits and separately reject unauthorized changes to the signed envelope.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The archived Willow comparison identifies scope-limited reconciliation and authorization concepts; it marks confidential sync as an evolving proposal.
recommended_disposition: Borrow scoped byte and path budgets as a design input. Test negative authorization cases before any interoperable adapter claim.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Two peers independently converge on their permitted intersection and do not disclose records outside the requested grant.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The Part C record covers recommendation, search and storage economics, and distinguishes profile ContentId from payload identity.
recommended_disposition: Retain model and policy provenance in derived results and publish fixture identity separately from local ranking.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: Rebuild one permitted query from scratch. Changing model ID invalidates the derived index while graph identity stays stable.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The proposal separates data ports, permits distinct backend implementations, and requires fixed validation and authorization checks around hooks.
recommended_disposition: Use capability availability as conformance data and derive projections through common acceptance semantics.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: A hook cannot waive a mandatory validation, replay or authorization gate. Every backend reports explicit gaps.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The Nov 23 decision separates listing ownership and operator attestations, verifies bounded records offline, and makes suspension and delisting append-only. It leaves hire, runtime and trust to separate slices.
recommended_disposition: Use the exact listing ID and head hash at hire. Keep consent at genesis, authority at hire, and marketplace pricing outside the record.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: A suspended listing refuses a new hire, a different registry can take its own listing decision, and signed immutable history stays readable.

archival_decision_or_proposal: The Nov 23 workflow records per-app tags on exact tested commits within the existing ratified scheme, subject to its first-tag implementation gate.
recommended_disposition: Bind each platform’s artifact and conformance report to the common tested commit and accepted tagging procedure.
prerequisite_or_test_oracle: A tag proposal referencing a different commit or missing evidence fails the specified gate. A design record cannot cut a release.
